With this, attackers can also create and read arbitrary files on the Expedition system.

items.name: Palo Alto Networks Expedition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.description: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to run arbitrary OS commands as root in Expedition, resulting in disclosure of usernames, cleartext passwords, device configurations, and device API keys of PAN-OS firewalls.

items.name: Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
items.description: Microsoft Windows Task Scheduler contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that can allow an attacker-provided, local application to escalate privileges outside of its AppContainer, and access privileged RPC functions.

items.name: Microsoft Windows NTLMv2 Hash Disclosure Spoofing Vulnerability
items.description: Microsoft Windows contains an NTLMv2 hash spoofing vulnerability that could result in disclosing a user's NTLMv2 hash to an attacker via a file open operation. The attacker could then leverage this hash to impersonate that user.

items.name: Metabase GeoJSON API Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
items.description: Metabase contains a local file inclusion vulnerability in the custom map support in the API to read GeoJSON formatted data.

items.name: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center Path Traversal Vulnerability
items.description: Atlassian Jira Server and Data Center contain a path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to read particular files in the /WEB-INF/web.xml endpoint.

items.name: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.description: Cisco Adaptive Security Appliance (ASA) contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the WebVPN login page. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via an unspecified parameter.

items.name: Palo Alto Networks Expedition Missing Authentication Vulnerability
items.description: Palo Alto Networks Expedition contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows an attacker with network access to takeover an Expedition admin account and potentially access configuration secrets, credentials, and other data.

items.name: CyberPanel Incorrect Default Permissions Vulnerability

items.name: Android Framework Privilege Escalation Vulnerability

items.name: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras OS Command Injection Vulnerability
items.description: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an OS command injection vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to escalate privileges to root via a crafted payload with the ntp_addr parameter of the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script.

items.name: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI Cameras Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
items.description: PTZOptics PT30X-SDI/NDI cameras contain an insecure direct object reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a remote, attacker to bypass authentication for the /cgi-bin/param.cgi CGI script. If combined with CVE-2024-8957, this can lead to remote code execution as root.

items.name: RoundCube Webmail Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
items.description: RoundCube Webmail contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the handling of SVG animate attributes that allows a remote attacker to run malicious JavaScript code.
